00037e71757d4d10761e828b34f002e41361e607.caption: Medium textarea with Label, "Input" text and "0/100" counter, with measurements showing the minimum height of 96px (vertical, at the right of the field) and the minimum width of 288px (horizontal, below the field).

0d3d10c60bb9d2ef8551f238ad5c918373a3859b.caption: A textarea component with a medium size, enabled state, and no validation errors. The component is labeled "Label" and includes a counter displaying the current character count out of the maximum allowed. Callout 1 points to the textarea in its initial state with minimal height, while callout 2 points to the textarea expanded to near its maximum height. The measurements 67/200 and 198/200 refer to the number of characters entered out of the maximum limit of 200 characters.

13e7e521eca88b0d1920a890a7db331c661cf75a.caption: Two medium textareas, each with the label "Label", the text "Input" and the counter "0/100", with a circle highlighting the bottom right corner of each field. Callout 1 points at the left textarea, which has no resize handle (automatic scaling); callout 2 points at the right textarea, which has a resize handle in that corner (manual scaling).

3c9d30b563232ad5d25ca24a932d817012e16163.caption: Don't example: a medium textarea (Label, "Input", resize handle, counter "0/100") stretched across the full width of the 12-column main grid. The textarea should not span the whole main grid area; it belongs in the content area narrow and should not exceed the recommended maximum width of 544px, for better scanability and readability.

417835b454159b4964381bed0b4408451f4afc4e.caption: Two textareas (Label, "Input", "0/100") inside a "Content area Narrow" container. In the first the field fills the container width; in the second the container is wider than the field, and the field stays at the "recommended max. width 544px" while "Container Width" extends beyond it.

53ee54e0cc3aa446cbd5ce0b2451c80456bfa170.caption: A text-area-medium component with the label "Label" and a text input that has reached near its character limit, indicated by the counter showing "67/200". The text area includes a native scroll bar because the text exceeds the maximum height, and it is in an enabled state without any validation errors. The component also features a resize handle.

649daddfdf1c86d5367c5e7db530a68c6900727f.caption: Two medium textareas with "Input" and "0/100": the first with the label "Label *", where callout 1 points at the asterisk marking a required field; the second with the label "Label (optional)", where callout 2 points at the word "(optional)" marking an optional field.

9e4a90785e35d639653af9d3692f19d279f834a9.caption: The Textarea component in a UI design system, showing its various states and sizes. It includes two sizes, "Size Medium" and "Size Small," and displays states such as "Default," "Hover," "Focus," "Near limit," "Limit reached," "Disabled," and "Read-only." The component features a label, an input field, and system feedback messages of types "error," "info," and "warning." The numbers indicate character counts, with "0/100," "90/100," and "100/100" representing the number of characters entered out of a 100-character limit. The "is invalid" text indicates an error state. The "Label *" denotes a required field...

b6fdb43afaefe57c0f0de431a3319c858fe29553.caption: Medium textarea with the label "Label", an info button next to it (hovered with a pointer cursor), the placeholder "Input", a resize handle and the counter "0/100". Above the info button an open white popover with the text "You will usually find the Machine Number in the location shown in the illustrations" shows two line drawings of a STIHL engine unit and a trimmer, each with a leader line to a placeholder machine number "xxxxxxxxx".

be12d266e5693e1761836b0ca7a6ccff7c95876c.caption: Four variants of a textarea component with different states and character count indicators. Each textarea has a label, an input field, a resize handle, and a character counter. Callout 1 points to a textarea with a character count of 57/100, callout 2 points to a textarea with a character count of 161/200 and an info message indicating less than 20% of characters left, callout 3 points to a textarea at the character limit of 100/100 with a warning message, and callout 4 points to an invalid textarea required field with a system feedback message and 0/100 character count. The character count measures the number of characters entered in the textarea.

cc961d4158df60309b0b55124560340aac50381c.caption: Don't example: a medium textarea with the label "Label", an info button (hovered), the placeholder "Input", a resize handle and the counter "0/100", with a small white popover above the info button containing only the placeholder text "xxxx". This is wrong because the popover must not hold critical or required information; use the hint instead.

d7972fb5526ed73466df56d89a4594b8a2b3f1c3.caption: The anatomy of a Textarea component in various states and configurations. The numbered callouts point to specific parts of the Textarea: 1 points to the Label, 3 points to the Text area where user input is entered, 2 points to the Character count/limit, 4 points to the Character count/limit in a different state, 5 points to the Hint text, and 6 points to the Info Button. The figure shows different states of the Textarea, including enabled, near limit, and limit reached, with corresponding messages and visual indicators. The character count/limit measurement indicates the number of characters entered by the user out of the allowed limit.
